session_reflection.reflection_prompt: Review the session timeline and consider when the material felt easiest or hardest to follow. These room-level signals are prompts for reflection, not personal evaluations.

privacy_and_ethics.identity: Participant IDs are temporary tracker labels and are not linked to student names.
privacy_and_ethics.individual_scoring: No individual engagement score, grade, ranking, or peer comparison is generated.
privacy_and_ethics.limitations: Camera visibility is approximate. Room-level engagement indicators are shared session context and must not be attributed to an individual participant.
privacy_and_ethics.recommended_use: Private learner reflection and session review only; not grading, discipline, or high-stakes decisions.
